status: FROZEN, NOT EXECUTED — no game has been played and no seed consumed
authorization: the endpoint screen is UNAUTHORIZED; this plan exists so that authorizing it later cannot be an occasion to choose parameters

engine_endpoints.strong_mdPly: READ FROM THE SWEEP'S selection RECORD — deliberately not restated here, so the plan cannot drift from the cost rule

opening_plies_reason: moveNr >= 6 keeps T1j's UNSEEDED InitialMoves.firstMove() path unreached; this is a correctness requirement
balanced: every opening is played in both arms; 8 openings x 2 arms = 16 tasks

seed_block.disjointness: asserted against every prior interval at freeze time
seed_block.note: seeds are per-task and independent of T1j, whose opening randomness is bypassed rather than seeded; they exist so OUR side and task ordering are reproducible

per_ply_binding: every ply of every game binds both engines through the E3b-qualified adapter; ABORT ON THE FIRST DIVERGENCE
abort_rules: any per-ply state divergence between the engines
any T1j query that does not complete its requested depth
any illegal or null-sentinel move from either side
any postcondition failure: a Window/Frame, a non-headless jvm, a mutated host preference store, or an unauthorized reflective access
any seed outside the reserved block, or any repeat of a seed

stopping_rules.band_meaning: T1j's score rate against our side. Outside this band the screen cannot calibrate anything, which is exactly how the twixtbot anchor failed: it won 1.000 at every setting including no search.
stopping_rules.early_stop_saturated: stop as soon as the outcome is arithmetically outside the band whatever the remaining tasks do

outcomes.IN_BAND: score rate inside the band; a larger match may then be proposed
outcomes.SATURATED_T1J_TOO_STRONG: stop; T1j cannot calibrate against us
outcomes.SATURATED_T1J_TOO_WEAK: stop; T1j cannot calibrate against us
outcomes.INCONCLUSIVE: neither in-band nor saturated with the tasks run; a larger match may then be proposed

stopping_rules.explicit_inconclusive: INCONCLUSIVE is a first-class outcome. The screen must never force a decision it did not earn.
stopping_rules.larger_match: permitted ONLY if the screen lands IN_BAND or is genuinely INCONCLUSIVE; never after a SATURATED outcome

forbidden: strength monotonicity inferred from move differences or timing
absolute strength placement — T1j is uncalibrated, so any result is an ORDERING, not a placement
gating the anchor on reproducing our own ordering, which is circular
